_purpose: Quick-start reference for new Claude Code instances. Read this before touching any file.

project.name: AGV KIM2A Controller
project.description: Autonomous Guided Vehicle controller for a differential-drive tape-following robot. Controls hardware over Modbus TCP, CAN bus, TCP sockets, and SLMP/MC Protocol. All motion logic is async; Flask dashboard runs in a daemon thread.

architecture.pattern: Single asyncio event loop with concurrent tasks + one Flask daemon thread
architecture.shared_state: AMRState instance passed by reference to all tasks — no message passing between tasks except via queues inside AMRState

queues.di_queue: DI bit arrays produced by DIReader, consumed by manual_mode
queues.rfid_queue: RFID hex tag strings produced by RFIDReader, consumed by rfid_processor
queues.sensor_queue: CAN sensor frame dicts produced by CANReader, consumed by auto_mode and mode_manager
queues.ao_queue: Tuples (channel, float voltage) consumed by AOWriter

task_graph: DIReader.run        — Modbus TCP DI poll every 50ms → di_queue + state.latest_di
RFIDReader.run      — TCP socket RFID reader → rfid_queue
CANReader.run       — CAN bus MGS1600 sensor → sensor_queue + state.latest_sensor
DOWriter.run        — consumes do_queue → Modbus TCP coil writes
AOWriter.run        — consumes ao_queue → Modbus TCP register writes (DAC)
SLMPDriver.run      — run_in_executor sync PLC cycle every 20ms (reads+writes)
safety_watchdog     — polls driver health every 50ms, sets state.system_error
modes.mode_manager  — central FSM, spawns manual_mode or auto_mode as subtasks

config_system.mechanism: Loads profiles/{AGV_ID}.json at import time. AGV_ID from env var, default 'agv1_kim'. Falls back to parameters.json for backwards compat.

sections.networking: DIO_IP, AO_IP, MODBUS_PORT, DEVICE_ID, RFID_IP, RFID_PORT, SLMP_IP, SLMP_PORT
sections.io_mapping: DI_BASE, DO_BASE, NUM_DI(16), NUM_DO(16), AO_BASE, NUM_AO(2), DI_EMERGENCY, DI_FWD, DI_REV, DI_LEFT, DI_RIGHT, DI_MODE_SWITCH, DI_START, DI_RESET, DI_FLIPPED
sections.motor_channels: left/right → {do_fwd, do_rev, do_brake, ao_speed} channel indices
sections.speeds: MANUAL_TARGET_HIGH_SPEED, MANUAL_TARGET_SLOW_SPEED, AUTO_TARGET_HIGH_SPEED, AUTO_TARGET_SLOW_SPEED, AUTO_TARGET_APPROACH_SPEED, ACCEL_RATE
sections.pid_tuning: KP, TD, N (HIGH gains), KP_SLOW, TD_SLOW, N_SLOW (SLOW gains), TI, TI_DEADBAND, TI_MAX, DT, V_RED_COEF, V_RED_COEF_SLOW, OUTPUT_CLAMP_RPM, SR_ALPHA, SR_CAP
sections.can_sensor: SENSOR_COB_ID(390), FLAG_TAPE_DETECT(2), FLAG_LEFT_MARKER(4), FLAG_RIGHT_MARKER(8), FLAG_SENSOR_FAIL(128), CAN_TIMEOUT(0.5s), CAN_NODE_ID(6)
sections.sequences: List of sequence defs — see sequence_engine section

config_system.di_flipped: DI_FLIPPED in io_mapping (0/1). When 1, all DI bits are inverted at read time in DIReader. Use for modules where NO input = ON, signal = OFF. Default 0.

state.note: Has flat property shims for all sub-domain fields so existing code works without changes.

fields.system_error: bool — set by safety_watchdog on driver comms loss

fields.sequence_stop: bool — True = AGV holds brake and waits
fields.pending_sequence: str name of armed rfid_then_marker sequence or None
fields.reverse_auto_request: bool — set by Flask /api/reverse_auto to start reverse tape-follow

fields.latest_di: list[bool] — last DI bits from Modbus (after DI_FLIPPED applied)
fields.latest_sensor: dict — last CAN frame {left_mm, right_mm, tape_detected, left_marker, right_marker, sensor_failure}
fields.can_last_rx: float epoch — last CAN message time

fields.plc_sequence_request: int 0-16 → one-hot M201x output; None = all LOW
fields.plc_sequence_pulse_expire: float epoch — when to auto-clear sequence request

transitions.armed → reverse: state.reverse_auto_request True (set by Flask) + tape detected
transitions.reverse → armed: DI_RESET rising edge OR reverse_auto_request cleared

auto_mode.description: PID tape-following loop, shared for forward and reverse
auto_mode.direction_forward: error_sign=-1.0, speed modes active, sequence stops active, RFID marker hooks active
auto_mode.direction_reverse: error_sign=+1.0, fixed SLOW speed, no sequence stops, no RFID hooks
auto_mode.loop: Drain sensor_queue (keep latest frame only), compute PID, put voltages to ao_queue
auto_mode.tape_loss: Brake + reset PID on tape lost; re-arm forward/reverse on reacquire
auto_mode.can_timeout: Brake if time since can_last_rx > CAN_TIMEOUT
auto_mode.accel_ramp: current_target_speed ramps toward target at ACCEL_RATE * DT per cycle

manual_mode.description: Pendant jogging. Drains di_queue, maps button combos to motion primitives.
manual_mode.combos: fwd+left, fwd+right, rvs+left, rvs+right, fwd, rvs, left, right, idle

motion.drive_primitive: _drive(state, left_fwd, left_v, right_fwd, right_v) — puts DO+AO commands to queues

features: Filtered derivative (low-pass, coefficient alpha = dt / (td/n + dt))
Integral with deadband (only accumulates if |e| < TI_DEADBAND)
Speed reduction: low-pass filtered, capped at SR_CAP * base_rpm
Live gain switching via update_gains() — does NOT reset integrator
reset() zeros integral, last_pv, filtered_d, speed_reduction
pid_controller.output_to_wheels: left_rpm = base_rpm - speed_reduction + output; right_rpm = base_rpm - speed_reduction - output

sequence_engine.description: Declarative JSON-driven sequence runner. No Python changes needed to add sequences — edit profile JSON.

trigger_types.rfid: Fires immediately when matching RFID tag is read
trigger_types.marker: Fires when matching tape marker (left/right) detected by auto_mode
trigger_types.rfid_then_marker: RFID arms approach (slows to SLOW), marker fires execution

action_types.wait_marker: Polls state.latest_sensor until side marker seen or timeout
action_types.sequence_stop: Timed stop: stop for duration seconds then auto-resume
action_types.plc_request: Sets plc_sequence_request + pulse expire for SLMP one-hot output
action_types.wait_plc_complete: Phase A: wait for complete flag LOW (PLC ack). Phase B: wait for HIGH (PLC done).

sequence_engine.preconditions: requires_mode check + cooldown check + no active sequence (one at a time)
sequence_engine.rfid_then_marker_flow: RFID → arm in self._armed, speed_mode=SLOW → marker → skip set_speed+wait_marker steps → run remaining actions
sequence_engine.cancel_armed: Called by mode_manager on any mode transition to flush stale armed state
sequence_engine.extensibility: register_action(name, async_handler) to add custom action types

base.SensorDriver: ABC with _record_rx() and get_health() → {ok, last_rx, detail}. Monitored by safety_watchdog.

DIReader.di_flipped: If config.DI_FLIPPED is True, all bits are NOT-ed before writing to state

CANReader.hardware: CANable2 USB adapter (VID=0x16D0, PID=0x117E), slcan interface, 500kbps
CANReader.auto_discovery: _find_canable_port() scans USB serial ports by VID/PID

RFIDReader.hardware: RFID reader over raw TCP socket
RFIDReader.protocol: Send RFID_INIT_CMD on connect, parse incoming hex stream split on 'CF' delimiter, tag = packet[26:30]

SLMPDriver.hardware: Mitsubishi FX5U PLC via SLMP/MC Protocol (pymcprotocol Type3E binary)

writes.M2000-M2005: AGV status bits: READY, EMERGENCY, TROLLEY_EMERGENCY, MANUAL, AUTO, RUNNING

reads.M0-M4: PLC inputs: PB_START_AUTO, MODE_MAN, MODE_AUTO, EMERGENCY, MASTER_ON → state.plc_inputs

safety_watchdog.fault_action: state.system_error = True + immediately zeros ao_queue (channels 0 and 1 → 0.0V)
safety_watchdog.recovery: state.system_error cleared when all drivers healthy again
safety_watchdog.mode_manager_response: On system_error, mode_manager cancels active task and brakes

rfid_processor.role: Thin dispatcher. Awaits state.rfid_queue, calls engine.on_rfid_tag(tag_hex).

web_dashboard.thread_safety: GIL-safe for reads; single-attribute writes (plc_sequence_request, reverse_auto_request) are atomic

endpoints.GET /api/state: Full JSON snapshot of AGV, PLC writes, PLC reads, sensor, sequence engine status
endpoints.POST /api/sequence: Set (requires MASTER_ON + MANUAL_MODE) or clear sequence request. Body: {sequence: int|null}
endpoints.POST /api/reverse_auto: Start/stop reverse tape-follow. Body: {running: true|false}. Requires mode='armed' to start.

shutdown.trigger: SIGTERM or SIGINT cancels all asyncio tasks
shutdown.procedure: On CancelledError: opens fresh Modbus clients, zeros all DO (NUM_DO coils) and AO (NUM_AO registers) directly, bypassing queues

outputs.file: DEBUG and above, rotating 10MB × 5 files in ./logs/agv_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log

level_conventions.DEBUG: High-frequency: PID loop values, raw sensor frames
level_conventions.INFO: Normal events: connections, mode transitions, sequence start/stop
level_conventions.WARNING: Recoverable faults: tape loss, CAN timeout, reconnects

read_dio.py.description: Connects to DIO Modbus and continuously prints all 16 DI states every 320ms. Ctrl+C to stop.

check_connections.py.description: Pings all network devices (DIO, AO, RFID, SLMP) and checks CANable2 USB presence. 3 retries × 2s interval. Prints summary.
check_connections.py.note: Uses system ping (-c 1 -W 1) for network checks — application-level protocol not verified

motor_test.py.description: Standalone synchronous motor direction verification script. Reads parameters.json directly (NOT config.py). Commands LEFT=FWD, RIGHT=REV at TEST_VOLTAGE for RUN_DURATION seconds, then auto-stops. LEFT_REVERSED / RIGHT_REVERSED flags swap FWD/REV coils per side. Uses sync ModbusTcpClient. CAUTION: AGV physically moves.

plotter.py.description: RunRecorder class imported by modes.py auto_mode. Controlled by PLOTTING_ENABLED flag (True/False, zero overhead when False). On stop() saves PNG + CSV to PLOT_DIR (analysis_plot/). PNG: dual-axis — Left/Right RPM (left axis 0-2000) and tracking error mm (right axis -100 to +100) vs time. CSV columns: time_s, error_mm, left_rpm, right_rpm, pid_output, d_term. Both files prefixed YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.

debug.py.description: Full async multi-subsystem hardware monitor. Enable subsystems via SHOW_DI/DO/AO/CAN/RFID flags. Filter channels via WATCH_DI/DO/AO lists (None = all). Polling: DI 10Hz, DO/AO 5Hz. COMPACT_DI/DO mode prints bitstring instead of per-channel. CAN uses a background reader thread + asyncio.Queue bridge. RFID prints raw frame hex on incomplete frames. NOTE: reads raw Modbus DI bits — DI_FLIPPED is NOT applied here.

slmp_tester10.py.description: Minimal standalone PLC comms tester. Hardcoded IP 192.168.4.10:1280. Toggles M100-M104 every 0.5s and cycles D10/D11/D12 word values on an 8-step/4s pattern. Used for verifying SLMP connectivity and PLC ladder response. Not integrated with config.py.

web_template.description: Single HTML dashboard page served by Flask at /. Polls /api/state periodically to display live AGV mode, sensor, PLC, and sequence status.

DIO_module.di_flipped: Currently 1 in agv1_kim profile — bits are inverted

legacy_and_shims.io_hardware.py: Backwards-compat shim re-exporting all drivers. Import from drivers/*.py for new code.
legacy_and_shims.slmp_handler.py: Standalone duplicate of SLMPDriver logic. Not used by main.py (which uses SLMPDriver from drivers/slmp_plc.py directly).
legacy_and_shims.module_shims: Each driver file also exposes a module-level function (di_reader, can_reader, etc.) wrapping a private _instance for backwards compat.

key_design_rules: Never block the asyncio event loop — all sync hardware calls use run_in_executor
Queues are drained fully each cycle (keep-latest pattern) to avoid stale data accumulation
All motion commands go through motion.py queues — never write DO/AO directly except in shutdown()
One sequence runs at a time — _active_sequence guard in SequenceEngine
mode_manager owns all mode transitions — auto_mode and manual_mode are passive subtasks
safety_watchdog and mode_manager are the only tasks that can halt motion unilaterally
Profile JSON is the only place to add/modify sequences — zero Python changes needed
DI_FLIPPED inverts at read time in DIReader — all downstream code sees logical values
